WITH aug_returns AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        sr.sr_ticket_number AS ticket_number,
        sr.sr_item_sk AS item_sk,
        sr.sr_customer_sk AS customer_sk,
        sr.sr_returned_date_sk AS returned_date_sk
    FROM store_returns AS sr
    JOIN date_dim AS d2
      ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
     AND d2.d_year = 2001
     AND d2.d_moy = 8
)
SELECT
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip,
    SUM(g."30 days")::bigint AS "30 days",
    SUM(g."31-60 days")::bigint AS "31-60 days",
    SUM(g."61-90 days")::bigint AS "61-90 days",
    SUM(g."91-120 days")::bigint AS "91-120 days",
    SUM(g.">120 days")::bigint AS ">120 days"
FROM (
    SELECT
        sale.store_sk AS store_sk,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE calc.gap <= 30) AS "30 days",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE calc.gap > 30 AND calc.gap <= 60) AS "31-60 days",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE calc.gap > 60 AND calc.gap <= 90) AS "61-90 days",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE calc.gap > 90 AND calc.gap <= 120) AS "91-120 days",
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE calc.gap > 120) AS ">120 days"
    FROM aug_returns AS ar
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS sold_date_sk,
            ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
            ss.ss_ticket_number AS ticket_number,
            ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
            ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk
        FROM store_sales AS ss
        WHERE ss.ss_ticket_number = ar.ticket_number
          AND ss.ss_item_sk = ar.item_sk
          AND ss.ss_customer_sk = ar.customer_sk
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS sale ON true
    JOIN date_dim AS d1
      ON sale.sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT ar.returned_date_sk - sale.sold_date_sk AS gap
    ) AS calc ON true
    GROUP BY sale.store_sk
) AS g
JOIN store AS s
  ON s.s_store_sk = g.store_sk
GROUP BY
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip
ORDER BY
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_company_id,
    s.s_street_number,
    s.s_street_name,
    s.s_street_type,
    s.s_suite_number,
    s.s_city,
    s.s_county,
    s.s_state,
    s.s_zip
LIMIT 100
